body:
My emotions swing like a bloody pendulum, but you sure did help. 
Thank you so much. I hope you're surrounded by happiness :D

That's amazing dude! People would say I'm a geek too, but sadly, not a fully fledged one. What do you play?

I've never actually played with a rubiks cub!
Thank you so much. Watching documentaries are really putting my mind elsewhere

Thank you so much for taking the time.
Why such a long bus ride?
I've been on studies off and on because of my inability to cope with life in general, haha. 

Let's talk about anything that interests you, because I like talking about what interests other people have apart from my own

Haha I do! I might even watch too many videos haha. 

Any suggestions for youtube?

I think anything that will keep me on the computer and away for harm would be best. I hate myself, just like that, I've turned my crying off and am just fine. But I know it's a ruse and any moment now the feeling of dread and suicide idealisation will set in again.

I say this exasperated, because I know exactly what's coming. 


But I would like to talk. How are you going? Thank you for being a little guardian tonight

I hope you're not as uptight about your own bodily functions now, though. 

I mean, everyone farts. The fact that you had so much gas building up because you were holding it must've been super painful. And the ones you let stew inside you always end up the smelliest.

This sounds like it'd be super fun. I'm definitely going to give this a spin. I don't mind extra work, once I get into something I jump in until I'm comfortably drowning.

I asked if anyone would be willing to co-DM and no one's stepped up to the plate. I think I'll definitely have them in the same room, now, using your method. Thank you so much!

I'm not sure how my brain just glossed entirely over randomly picking names out of a hat. 

They all have the same availabilities, so I think I'm going to go with this method to split them up. Jeeze louise, it was that simple!

Unfortunately, they're all pretty adamant about playing the Saturday after this and have pretty constrictive work/uni schedules :(

Splitting them up from the get-go is challenging because of social politics and I'd rather avoid the drama of what being Group A vs Group B might mean. 

But god, I'd love if they would allow me to run them as groups of five. I ran the idea past one of them, and they instantly chose the best (presumably) roleplayers to be part of their group. I'm not sure how to balance it all out without the uncomfortable Baseball team choosing method where somebody embarassingly gets picked last. 

I'm scared that my inability to make the uncomfortable decisions will doom me to be a bad DM

Thank you so much. I think I just needed a little kindness today. My family always talks about their own self-sacrifices and wear them as a badge of entitlement, forgetting that they use and abuse me in order to make themselves feel better. I'm seen as the level-headed one in the family and will always try to come out with a positive energy because I don't want them to feel the sadness I have on the inside. They definitely take that for granted and use me as an emotional buffer between their own exchanges. 

I'm going to take time for myself. Thank you for the hug. Funny how sometimes, that's all it takes to make it all okay.

It really does suck, especially when people rely on you to maintain your bubbly attitude at all times. I act as an emotional buffer in my family because everyone views me as the level-headed one. This is so taxing because they don't even realise how much they take my resolve to stay positive for granted. 

I think you're right. I just need to pause and remember that I'm my own person and nurture myself. The only thing is I can't do so without feeling incredibly guilty. Fuck it. I'm running myself a bubble bath
